title: House cross-office name link candidate
description: One row per (person_key, office_key_a, office_key_b) for every payee name observed in more than one House office. A link row records what the disbursement rows show about the two office-scoped atoms carrying the same name, and which rule that evidence triggers. It is NEVER an identity finding: SHARED_EMPLOYEE and MID_QUARTER_MOVE record a same-person reading, SEQUENTIAL_CANDIDATE records an unresolved candidate, and TRUE_COLLISION records that the two atoms are kept apart. No row promotes a canonical identity.

link_class.description: SHARED_EMPLOYEE: the two offices co-occur in at least one quarter and EVERY co-occurring quarter prints a SHARED EMPLOYEE title. MID_QUARTER_MOVE: they co-occur in a quarter with no shared title and the two offices' service-date ranges never touch at day level. TRUE_COLLISION: they co-occur in a quarter with no shared title and the service-date ranges DO touch at day level. SEQUENTIAL_CANDIDATE: the two offices never co-occur in a quarter.

link_subclass.description: Set on TRUE_COLLISION only; the container-kind shape of the pair, for triage. Precedence: BOTH_COMMITTEE (both sides committee), COMMITTEE_AND_MEMBER (one side committee, the other a member container - member_office, member_office_unresolved or vacant_seat), LEADERSHIP_AND_OTHER (either side leadership), MEMBER_AND_MEMBER (both sides member containers), ADMIN_AND_OTHER (either side admin), then OTHER as a genuinely miscellaneous residual. container_kind_pair carries the raw shape on every row regardless, so the subclass is never the only record of the shape.

deciding_quarter.description: The quarter whose evidence the link_class is reported against. On TRUE_COLLISION this is the STRONGEST instance - the co-quarter with no shared title carrying the largest day-level overlap - and deciding_intervals_a/b and overlap_days describe that quarter. On MID_QUARTER_MOVE and SHARED_EMPLOYEE it is the earliest qualifying co-quarter. Null on SEQUENTIAL_CANDIDATE. Pair with first_overlap_quarter, which gives the EARLIEST instance; neither reading requires a rebuild to recover.

first_overlap_quarter.description: Set on TRUE_COLLISION only: the EARLIEST co-quarter with no shared title that carries a day-level overlap, so the earliest evidence is never buried behind the maximum-overlap choice in deciding_quarter. Null on every other link_class.

ledger_shared_flag_circular.description: Always true. See house_person_identity.schema.json. The two ledger_shared_flag_any_* fields are context and are read by no rule.
